description: Abstract base class for Drupal image effect forms, providing form building, validation, and submission logic for image effects.

classes.name: ImageEffectFormBase
classes.description: Abstract class providing a base form for image effects in Drupal, handling form creation, validation, and submission.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Builds the image effect configuration form, handling effect preparation and form element setup.

methods.name: validateForm
methods.description: Validates the form by passing configuration data to the image effect's validation method.

methods.name: submitForm
methods.description: Handles form submission, saving configuration and applying the image effect to the style.

methods.name: prepareImageEffect
methods.description: Abstract method to convert an image effect ID into an effect object.
